text: {"lessons":["My account fell from its early-period high before recovering slightly, so I should judge progress over a longer horizon rather than react to one month’s return.","Mostly holding through the declines avoided impulsive trades; I should keep trading only when a clear, forward-looking reason changes.","Selling part of Stock C at a gain felt good, but I should base future sells on its outlook, portfolio risk, and target allocation—not on the pleasure of locking in gains or discomfort with losses."]}
